defective_pattern: Writing 'p = ۰.۰۱۴', '۰.۰۰۱ > p', or '(p = .۰۰۷)' inside table data cells.
why_defective: Causes symbol duplication with the column header, clutters the data grid, and fails standard APA 7 and journal formatting checks.
observed_symptoms: '۰.۰۰۱ > p' in normality or descriptive tables
'p' letter appearing in numeric data columns
corrective_remedy: Strip all 'p', 'P', 'p =', and '> p' occurrences from table cells; output pure numbers (e.g. '۰.۰۱۴') or inequality with number ('< ۰.۰۰۱' / '۰.۰۰۱ >').

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of 'p =' or 'p <' or '> p' strings inside any standard table cell whose header designates a p-value column.
